A single house fly traped behind the blinds of a window, bumping against the glass. Fly by.

freesound.title: R4_00332-1_FR_FlyInRoom.wav
freesound.desc:
A fly in the room (1st file). 
Flying around, then hitting the window. 
Recorded in May 2022 with a Centrance MixerFace R4R and Rode NT5 MP + NT45O capsules in AB position (about 30cm). 
Fade in/out applied in Audacity. 
No insect has been hurt for this recording, I opened the window at the end !

freesound.title: Moth spiralling into a fluorescent light.wav
freesound.desc: A moth attracted to a fluorescent light outside.  Slamming into the light spiralling down. Upside down bicycle used, spinning its wheel, pressing a piece of torn paper in it.

Recorded on a stereo Audio Technica BP4025 into a Zoom F8 Mixer
